detail.longDescription:
Elevate your home in seconds—redesign rooms, stage properties, declutter photos, and plan beautiful outdoor spaces with Cozy AI, your personal Design Agent.
Just take or upload a photo, pick a style (or simply tell the agent what you want), and get realistic, magazine-worthy results—no design skills needed.

Your Design Agent (Chat Edit + Precise Control)
Cozy AI isn’t just a style filter. It’s an interactive Design Agent that helps you iterate until it feels right:
- Chat Edit: Describe your dream look in natural language (e.g., “make it warmer, modern, and brighter”).
- Reference-Guided: Upload an inspiration photo or moodboard—Cozy AI matches the vibe.
- Brush to Edit: Paint over a specific area to change only what you want (sofas, rugs, walls, cabinets, decor), while keeping lighting, perspective, and scale consistent.

Interior Design in One Tap
Turn any room into a new vision:
- Restyle & Style Matching: Try multiple aesthetics with consistent, realistic results.
- Virtual Staging: Fill empty rooms with furniture and decor—perfect for listings.
- Replace & Place: Swap furniture, art, lighting, or decor with precise edits.
- Removal (Declutter): Erase unwanted objects, stains, or distractions for a cleaner space.
- Enhance: Improve brightness, contrast, color, and clarity for photo-ready visuals.

Outdoor Design (Backyard, Front Yard & Garden)
Design your outdoor space like an interior—with styles + components you choose:
- Select an outdoor style (modern, cozy rustic, Mediterranean, Zen, tropical, etc.)
- Pick Exterior Type: Garden, Pool Yard, BBQ Area, Kids' Yard, Dining Yard and more
- Get a cohesive yard & garden redesign that feels practical, beautiful, and ready to build

Perfect For
- Homeowners & renters planning a refresh or renovation
- Real estate agents needing fast virtual staging
- Designers, creators, and DIYers exploring ideas and moodboards
- Anyone who wants to compare options, save versions, and share with family, contractors, or clients
Save your favorite designs, compare iterations, and share instantly. Download Cozy AI and start designing—inside and out.

We always welcome your thoughts and suggestions. You can contact us via cs@collov.com.
